correctness.rationale: For a finite linear combination of left-regular partial permutations, the matrix of the involuted element is the conjugate transpose. Exact row-sum and column-sum formulas therefore give the semigroup \(\ell^\infty\)/\ell^1\) norm duality. Combining it with the published groupoid endpoint duality and the published \(p=1\) reduced comparison proves the missing endpoint. Finite-exponent equality plus the endpoint equality gives equality of every \(P\)-supremum norm, and Steinberg \(I\)-norm density gives surjectivity of the completed map.
